events.label: Renault Founded
events.fact: Louis Renault and brothers founded the French automaker in Billancourt.

events.label: Ford Motor Company Founded
events.fact: Henry Ford launched the company that later introduced the Model T.

events.label: Wall Street Crash of 1929
events.fact: Major stock market collapse signaling the onset of the Great Depression.

events.label: Toyota Motor Corporation Founded
events.fact: Spun off from Toyoda Automatic Loom Works in Japan.

events.label: Hyundai Motor Company Founded
events.fact: Founded in South Korea, later expanding into a global automaker.

events.label: Microsoft Founded
events.fact: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded the software company in Albuquerque.

events.label: Amazon Founded
events.fact: Launched by Jeff Bezos as an online bookstore in Washington state.

events.label: Lehman Brothers Bankruptcy
events.fact: Peak crisis event of the global financial crash and Great Recession.

events.label: COVID-19 Market Crash
events.fact: Rapid global equity sell-off in early 2020 as pandemic lockdowns began.

events.label: Julius Caesar Assassinated
events.fact: Roman dictator assassinated on the Ides of March in Rome.

events.label: Abraham Lincoln Assassinated
events.fact: Shot at Ford's Theatre in Washington, D.C., by John Wilkes Booth.

events.label: William McKinley Assassinated
events.fact: Shot at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo, New York.

events.label: Mona Lisa Stolen from Louvre
events.fact: Vincenzo Peruggia stole the painting, which was recovered two years later in Florence.

events.label: Mahatma Gandhi Assassinated
events.fact: Assassinated in New Delhi while holding an evening prayer meeting.

events.label: Brink's Armored Car Robbery
events.fact: Thieves stole more than $2.7 million in cash and checks in Boston.

events.label: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum Heist
events.fact: Thirteen artworks were stolen in Boston and remain unsolved.

events.label: Citizens United v. FEC
events.fact: Supreme Court ruling addressing independent political spending by corporations and unions.

events.label: Dresden Green Vault Heist
events.fact: Historic 18th-century diamond jewelry stolen from Dresden's Green Vault.

events.label: Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar
events.fact: Milton Hershey introduced the mass-produced milk chocolate bar in the U.S..

events.label: Reese's Peanut Butter Cups Name
events.fact: H. B. Reese introduced the chocolate and peanut butter cup candy.

events.label: Dairy Queen First Store
events.fact: Soft-serve ice cream shop opened in Joliet, Illinois.

events.label: M&M's Introduced
events.fact: Sugar-coated chocolate candies debuted for U.S. military rations.

events.label: Jolly Rancher Founded
events.fact: Brand originally launched in Golden, Colorado, as an ice cream and candy shop.

events.label: Pez Candy Dispensers Marketed to Kids
events.fact: Fruit-flavored compressed sugar candies paired with character dispensers.

events.label: Pringles Debuts Nationally
events.fact: Stacked saddle-shaped potato crisps introduced in a cylindrical can.

events.label: Hot Cheetos Introduced
events.fact: Spicy chili-cheese version of Cheetos became a major snack hit.

events.label: Chipotle Founded
events.fact: Steve Ells opened the first Chipotle Mexican Grill in Denver, Colorado.
